known_information: The issue and confirmations describe digits no longer selecting assigned FancyZones layouts during a drag.
Current FancyZones::OnKeyDown explicitly requires Win+Ctrl+Alt in the active-drag branch.

Mouse-wheel switching is a reported workaround, not an equivalent fix for laptop/no-wheel use.
